source.limits: Manufacturer limits, Table 3 (1 year), as printed
source.report_note: Limits are the manufacturer's, as printed in the Fluke 80 Series V Calibration Manual, Table 3 "Accuracy Tests" (printed pp. 9-11), "83 and 88" or "87" column as applies to the model.
source.note: Table 3 "Accuracy Tests" (printed pp. 9-11) of the Fluke 80 Series V Calibration Manual, two Display Reading columns ("83 and 88", "87"); plus the display test (p. 7), the pushbutton test (p. 9) and the backlight steps 51-53. 87V: all rows. 83V: the "83 and 88" column without steps 2, 4, 6, 8, 45, 46 (N/A), 47 (no Peak Min/Max, footnote 7) and 49-50 (temperature, 87 and 88 only). 88V: the "83 and 88" column with steps 47 and 49-50. Not built (owner decision): the 88V inductive pickup test (pp. 11-14, oscilloscope and function generator). Limits as printed (no corrections). The manual names a Fluke 5560A; the procedure drives a Fluke 5560A or 5522A (or you set the calibrator by hand). High-voltage points go straight to the test value (the manual prescribes no ramp); the HIGH VOLTAGE confirmation (30 V and above) is asked once per hook-up group. The meters have no remote interface: you type the display reading. Function names are the manual's own (Table 3, "Test Function"). The technician sets the meter up for each point: rotary switch position, range, any yellow-button press and Peak Min Max, as the prompt names them.

steps.title: Display test
steps.setup: Turn the meter on to V~ while holding down the AutoHOLD button to view all segments of the display. Compare the display with Figure 3 and Table 2 of the calibration manual (printed pp. 7-8).
steps.question: All display segments come on and match Figure 3 (no missing or extra segments).

steps.title: Pushbutton test
steps.setup: Turn the rotary knob to V~ (the first position, "Testing the Pushbuttons" step 1), then press each button.
steps.question: The meter beeps for each button press. Then press and hold MIN MAX a second time to exit MIN MAX mode.
